page.title: Findings
page.purpose: Show what the reconciler found: instances at a provider that this scenario has no record of, records with no instance behind them, and figures that disagree.

priorities.statement: What diverged, in which direction, and when it was observed.
That the reconciler reported this and did not act on it.
How to quarantine something before deciding what it is.
When the last sweep ran, so silence is distinguishable from cleanliness.

states.description: No open findings, with the last sweep time shown so an empty list is trustworthy.
The last sweep is older than its interval, so an empty list cannot be trusted and says so.
Findings render but the provider side of one comparison could not be read, so the list is known to be incomplete and says so.

elements.name: Finding
elements.description: Kind, provider, identifiers on whichever side is known, and what differed.

elements.name: Last sweep
elements.description: When the reconciler last completed, and its next scheduled run.

claims.statement: An empty list caused by a clean sweep is visually distinct from an empty list caused by a sweep that has not run recently.
claims.rationale: The dangerous failure is silence read as safety. A reconciler that stopped running looks exactly like a fleet with nothing wrong.

claims.statement: No destroy, terminate or resolve control exists anywhere on this page, in any state. Quarantine is the only action, and destruction happens deliberately from the instance page.
claims.rationale: Marking precedes sweeping so a reconciler defect cannot destroy a running node, including a paying customer's. This claim names no element on purpose: an element-absent claim that lists an element asserts that element is missing, and quarantine-action must be present.

claims.statement: Each finding states which side is missing, rather than only that something differs.
claims.rationale: Present at the provider and absent locally is money. Present locally and absent at the provider is a stuck meter. They need different responses.

claims.statement: Every declared state renders a distinct, readable surface.
